name: Mona
who: Bakes at home in Riyadh and has always wanted a stall at the weekend market. She has the recipes and no plan, and she wants to be walked through it a step at a time.
said: I'm Mona. I'm starting a new project, a weekend bakery stall, and I want a guide with the steps.

says.plain: I'm Mona. I'm starting a new project, a weekend bakery stall, and I want a guide with the steps.
says.hard: I've always wanted to open a small bakery stall at the weekend market.

first: Asked the market about a stall, they said 300 a weekend

said: Picked four things to sell: date cookies, cardamom buns, sourdough, kunafa bites
Booked the stall for the first weekend of November
First weekend sold out by noon
Selling every weekend now, thinking of a second stall

promises.says: nothing is saved until you keep it
